==English==
{{Zodiac|en|Image:Libra.svg|Virgo|Scorpio|w=Libra (astrology)}}
[[File:Libra constellation map negative cropped.png|thumb|The constellation Libra]]

===Etymology===
From {{uder|en|la|lībra||scales, balance}}, {{calque|en|grc|ζυγόν|nocap=1|nocat=1}}, {{calque|grc|akk|𒀯𒍣𒁀𒉌𒌈||scales|tr=<sup>mul</sup>zibānītum|nocap=1|nocat=1}}, from {{der|en|sux|𒀯𒍣𒁀𒀭𒈾||scales|tr=<sup>mul</sup>ZI.BA.AN.NA}}.<ref>John H. Roger "Origins of the ancient constellations: I. The Mesopotamian traditions" ''Journal of the British Astronomy Association'' '''108''': 1, p. 14, 17, 26.</ref> {{doublet|en|arratel|libbra|libra|lira|litra|litre|livre|rottol}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈliːbɹə/}}
* {{homophones|en|libre}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-Libra.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|iːbɹə|s=2}}

===Proper noun===
{{en-proper noun}} (symbol [[♎]]︎)

# {{senseid|en|Q10580}}{{lb|en|zodiac constellations}} A [[constellation]] of the [[zodiac]], traditionally [[figured]] in the shape of a set of weighing [[scales]], though earlier figured as the [[claw]]s of [[Scorpio]].
#: {{synonyms|en|Balance|Balances|Scales|alt1=the Balance|alt2=the Balances|alt3=the Scales}}
# {{senseid|en|Q134394}}{{lb|en|astrology}} The [[astrological]] sign for the [[Scales]], ruled by Venus and covering September 24 - October 23 ([[tropical astrology]]) or October 16 - November 16 ([[sidereal astrology]]).
